name: aluminum hydroxide + dimethicone + magnesium hydroxide
uses: Uses Relieves: ▪ heartburn ▪ sour stomach ▪ acid indigestion ▪ bloating, pressure and discomfort commonly referred to as gas
otcwarn: Ask a doctor before use if you have ▪ kidney disease ▪ a magnesium-restricted diet Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are now taking a prescription drug. Antacids may interact with certain prescription drugs. Stop use and ask a doctor if symptoms last more than 2 weeks.
